name: dobe_rub3b
desc: pink goo doberman seen from behind hugging someone tightly against its broad muscular chest, grinding its chest against them by sliding its whole upper body straight UP and DOWN: it rises up by about eight pixels then sinks back down, heavy and sticky, the shoulders and back muscles heave with each stroke, goo squishing and stretching. Strictly vertical motion, no side-to-side swaying, no leaning left or right. Its arms keep hugging, its head stays pressed in with eyes hidden, its lower body stays stuck to the goo pillar and does not move, looping
